glosses: organ (a larger part of an organism)
organ (a musical instrument made of multiple pipes)
organ, bulletin (an official publication of an organization)

examples.text: Usualmente hay un órgano en una iglesia.
examples.en: There is usually an organ in a church.

examples.text: El cáncer se había extendido a varios órganos.
examples.en: The cancer had spread to several organs.

examples.text: Si donas un órgano, podrías salvar una vida.
examples.en: If you donate an organ, you could save a life.

examples.text: ¿Alguna vez has pensado en donar tus órganos después de morir?
examples.en: Have you ever thought about donating your organs after you die?
